[[Motostoke]] |scheme=Paldea }} (Japanese: '''{{ruby|Ｖ|ブイ}}{{ruby|Ｓ|エス}}ガラルファイヤー''' ''VS {{tt|Galar Fire|Galarian Moltres}}'') is the second regular chapter of the {{OBP|Anime Pocket Monsters: Liko and Roy's Adventure|manga}} manga. It was first published in the January 2024 issue of ''[[CoroCoro|CoroCoro Comics]]'', released on December 15, 2023.[https://web.archive.org/web/20240205062702/https://www.bookshop-ps.com/bsp/bsp_magcode?sha=1&sho=0380901124 ''CoroCoro Comics'' January 2024 issue | Shogakukan BOOK SHOP] (Japanese; archived)[https://web.archive.org/web/20231219102530/https://corocoro.jp/news/377970/ ''CoroCoro Comics'' January 2024 issue | CoroCoro Comics] (Japanese; archived)[https://web.archive.org/web/20231216163513/https://corocoro.jp/news/377807/ ''CoroCoro Comics'' January 2024 issue - Pocket Monsters | CoroCoro Comics] (Japanese; archived)[https://twitter.com/yamadaka_k56/status/1735577936734908798 Kei Yamadaka on Twitter] (Japanese) It is based on the {{pkmn|animated series}} episodes ''[[HZ022|Charge! Galar Mine!]]'' and ''[[HZ023|Fiery Galarian Moltres]]''. It is 49 pages long, including the color cover. ==Plot== {{Incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * [[Liko]] and [[Roy]] are revealed to have joined the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]]. * Liko is revealed to have {{pkmn2|caught}} a {{TP|Liko|Hatenna}}. * A {{an|Terapagos|mysterious Pokémon}} is revealed to have emerged from Liko's pendant before. * The Rising Volt Tacklers encounter [[Amethio]] again. * Liko and Roy encounter [[Lucius]]'s third Pokémon, a {{rf|Galarian}} {{TP|Lucius|Moltres}}. * Liko is revealed to have taken under her care Lucius's second Pokémon, a {{pkmn2|giant}} {{TP|Lucius|Arboliva}}. * Roy is revealed to have {{pkmn2|caught}} a {{TP|Roy|Wattrel}}. * Lucius's Galarian Moltres goes inside the third [[Ancient Poké Ball]] and is taken under Liko's care. * The mysterious Pokémon emerges from Liko's pendant again, but does not change back. ===Debuts=== ====Humans==== * [[Dot]] (in person) * [[Nurse Joy]] * [[Lucius]] (illusion) ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Hatenna}} ({{OP|Liko|Hatenna}}) * {{p|Terapagos}} ({{an|Terapagos|anime}};
